triage.note: Pair B of two, and the harder half: here every NAME on the wire is correct and every pinned expression is spelled right — only the VALUE is wrong, or the pinned text is present but is not the text that runs. Seven shapes, one failure each, exact count. Four came from PR #27 R6: the fixture handler inverts the flag (`not bool(...)`), so default-OFF becomes always-exclude; the upload handler compares `!= "1"`, a one-character typo that makes EVERY upload exclude because with the box unticked the query parameter is absent and `None != "1"` is True; the url handler forwards a constant (`False and bool(...)`); and a fourth `/api/extract/paste` mode exists that never wires the flag. Three more were found by attacking the round-2 allow-list itself rather than the hops it pins, and all three passed it before they were closed: a SECOND `excludeBp` definition shadowing the pinned one (JS declarations hoist, the last one binds), a `disabled` checkbox that can never be ticked while every hop stays intact, and a call site commented out with its pinned expression left in the file as dead text.
triage.why_two_pairs: The shapes conflict per slot — a handler can be inverted or renamed but not both, and one file holds one excludeBp definition — so pinning all sixteen in a single pair is impossible without losing the exact count that makes a regressed over-fire visible (PR #21 round-2 R5).
